verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device inference engine, so CPU architecture coverage is a fair question to ask of it. Its documented platform support covers only Arm and x86/x64 across macOS, Linux and Windows. Nothing in the evidence documents PowerPC, RISC-V or any other CPU architecture, and the generic "any hardware" marketing line names device types, not architectures.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run inference on diverse CPU architectures beyond x86 and ARM, such as PowerPC
